source: Captured 2026-09-24 from a live Create request for Custom::AuthSecRegistration (stack AuthSec-Discovery-r3lewcg4, lab account), delivered through the us-east-1 callback topic. us-east-1 uses S3's global endpoint: no region in the host. Host and path are verbatim; the query parameter NAMES are verbatim and their values are redacted, because they are a presigned write credential.
